reviewMethod: Each active PNG was reopened at original detail for visual inspection. Hashes, dimensions and robust outer margins were recomputed from the untouched PNG bytes.

criteria.architecture: complete frontal L5601 frame, central seam, two narrow left raised panels and two wide right raised panels
criteria.hardware: exactly two black modules; clean unlabeled round indicator dots or a blank upper module; lower module has at most one plain physical slot
criteria.branding: zero logos, badges, labels, pictograms, letters, digits, microtext and pseudo-text
criteria.framing: 0-8 px target; up to 11 px only when occupancy exceeds 98% and the complete frame remains intact

marginDetection.method: From each original edge, first row or column where at least 5% of pixels have any RGB channel below 245; measurement only, no pixel changes.
